featured_reviews.name: Rajat Rajput
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very pleasant shopping experience at Reliance Smart. The store was well-organized, clean, and easy to navigate, which made finding products convenient and hassle-free. The variety of items available, especially in groceries and daily essentials, was impressive, and the quality met my expectations.
I would also like to appreciate the staff for being courteous and helpful. They were attentive and ready to assist whenever needed, which enhanced the overall experience. The billing process was smooth and efficient, with minimal waiting time.
However, there is still some scope for improvement in maintaining consistent stock availability for certain popular items. Apart from that, everything was excellent.
Overall, I am satisfied with my visit and would definitely recommend Reliance Smart to others for a comfortable and reliable shopping experience.

featured_reviews.name: Durvankur Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ever since Reliance Smart has moved up to the 2nd floor, it has become more organised, and spacious. The items that you are looking for are generally available, but some you might find under combo offers only, or in large packs. The prices obviously are a little higher than D-Mart, and their offers don't entice me ever.

The best thing about Reliance is that it is less crowded than D-Mart, and you can shop peacefully. I guess it is the extra price you pay for. Their rewards system is a joke. In the last year and a half, we must have shopped closed to around Rs.13-15K, and all that we see in our rewards list is a reimbursement amount of Rs. 150.

featured_reviews.review_text: I went to Star Bazaar recently and really liked how organised the store is. Everything from vegetables and snacks to home essentials is easy to find, and the shelves are well-stocked. The quality of fresh items is good, and the prices are affordable with frequent offers.  It can get crowded in the evenings, but overall it's a great supermarket for daily needs.And the main thing is star bazaar is the on the shelter wher we get all the items for daily use and also toys for children and many more things.So my experience with star bazaar is very good.

featured_reviews.name: Anugraha Ghale
featured_reviews.review_text:
There’s something oddly calming about walking into a good supermarket. great supermarket inside Utopia Mall… spacious, well-organized, and full of variety. They have everything from fresh greens and salads to household essentials and kitchen items. I loved that they use paper bags for vegetables instead of plastic. Then the aisles opened up to everything else, dairy, grains, cleaning supplies, doormats, kitchen utensils, the whole rhythm of daily life, just sitting there on shelves.

The space itself was surprisingly open bright, The staff were kind and helpful, and even though they check your bill at the exit, it’s done politely and quickly. Good place to stop by even for cultural enrichment.

A place for home needs at one place. Utopia Garden grove mall is having sufficient open space for holding 500 to 1000 people. Items are good pricing is also better. But varieties and size of packets need to be checked..FEED BACK WILL DEFINITELY IMPROVE THE SALES.
Location is super. Atmosphere is best. Materials is of quality. Staff training is necessary. Security staff needs more HR training.
As per the items, Allmost all home needs are there. But some changes needs to be done. Varieties of papad is less. Only masala papad available. Normal papad is not available. Display of items are also not proper.
Staff training is required as too many are working in one place. Vegetable weighing counter staff are less which takes more time for customers.
The phone number of customers are recorded in the billing counter. But not displayed in the bill. It will be a useful one.    Rates are really best and economical. Needs to publicise the same to reach people. Which will make more customers to reach.
Billing is to be improved. Fast and perfect will bring a long time happy customers
